decisive_items: chest pain remained mild and worsened on inspiration
began acutely during an episode of gastroenteritis
response.rationale: Pericarditis best fits the pleuritic precordial pain following a viral gastrointestinal illness; the loud left-sternal clicking may represent an intense pericardial friction rub, though normal CRP and ECG are atypical. MVP does not explain inspiratory chest pain or an audible popping sound.

rejected.why: The clicking sound alone is insufficient; MVP clicks are not typically audible without a stethoscope and do not explain the pleuritic pain pattern.
